{"lines":[{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"類有傷官，墓神柱中尤惡。暗有刼財，庫鬼命分至凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1202,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官自有墓庫，如丙人土為傷官，遇辰自家墓神，若帶凶煞尅竊刑衝，日主併用神，至為𦂳切惡氣刼財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529651200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1205,"lineType":2,"content":"之庫墓。如丙人戌位，兼丁旺於上，帶凶煞前來，尅竊刑衝，其用神日主至凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬生鄉，宜乎潤澤，惡神死地，怕作刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"印綬本為生我之神，若值印綬，自家生旺之所，又見生合之神，轉轉為福，自家大義綿綿不絶，則可或滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"或溢，火出木焚，木浮水泛，土重金埋，火重土虛，水流金沉，反有太滿則傾，太盛則折之禍矣。凶惡之神，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"家已在死絶之處，於上又乘惡氣，尅竊刑衝用神日主者狼狽。若死絶墓敗上宫主為惡來壊者，用前註斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"用神惡沒之所，地支豈欲全彰。納音生旺之方，用神坦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"然無忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1212,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用神之敗絶惡陷等位，柱中忌露，多是卑賤下格，更帶凶煞之神，可乎？恐見一二位猶可，或嵗運上扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157834252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1215,"lineType":2,"content":"起惡陷之氣，兼㑹煞局者，即為沉淪䘮敗、悔吝破失之氣類也，甚則死無葬身之地，須空亡併煞方㫁。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1216,"lineType":2,"content":"命之納音，常生常旺，四貴之地，月神來上，自然喜悦，皆無所忌憚，恬然自安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"火土之源，失中易化；塵濛之象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1218,"lineType":2,"content":"若火土不得造化中和之氣者，或燥或寒，或偏或枯，易於晦物之氣，乃滯暗昏濛之象，不能煥發，遇而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1219,"lineType":2,"content":"成者矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"死敗之象，有黨莫傷。生旺之神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"如死敗之象有黨，反來刑衝尅竊生旺之神，大不亨通之兆。如水人見卯家之木，酉金辰土巳火等神之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1222,"lineType":2,"content":"類，却将日主生旺日主用神生旺宫。主相犯相尅，為咎不小，宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870478374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣布定東西，地理能培能竭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1226,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子水，寅卯木，巳午火，申酉金，辰戌丑未土。如金到亥子，則氣泄而竭，木到亥子，受養得培。餘倣此推，極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"為切事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"一辰聚藏貴煞，納音自旺自生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"如一辰貴聚長生，帶煞在日時，為生煞同途。一云煞帶貴自長生，為有用。此為貴帶自生，又為煞中藏貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1230,"lineType":2,"content":"一云年中干音隨長生，同神煞在日時者，為真長生，乃聚年月日時之氣，乂為一强四弱。又云：四柱只要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"一位長生，專其旺氣，為聚斂精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡消息數端，豈止十干缺處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494453769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞最為要𦂳。中間輕重真假，宜仔細詳審。一旬空亡，十日分上下所管。如甲子旬中，五陽干用戌空為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1236,"lineType":2,"content":"切，五陰干用亥空為切。一、氣分輕重，甲子見壬戌真，空見戊戌輕。一云上肩一位太重，如甲人見癸，乙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1237,"lineType":2,"content":"見甲之類，即十惡大敗。一、旬中後禄遇空亡，如甲子旬壬申，甲戌旬庚辰之類。一五氣落空，如甲子旬水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1238,"lineType":2,"content":"土，甲戌旬金，甲申旬火土之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴抑扶兩立，稱停一路鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1240,"lineType":2,"content":"官星為一身之貴氣，福源第一切事，財神次之。若有一扶一抑，兩立其義，不分勝負，如陰陽氣不升降，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1241,"lineType":2,"content":"路運中，當稱停其配屬强弱之情，以察興廢可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"煞見官隠以託情，官顯煞藏而立義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694065127443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"煞見有露神制合，均配官隠，無印更隠者，主外有權謀操畧，内懷奸宄竒計。若煞重而無馭，官神無情者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1246,"lineType":2,"content":"反是官顯煞藏，内則性惡無情，外則義和謹節，大義如此，又當格物以消詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"忌煞氣專用神情，假用神力，切忌煞外馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1248,"lineType":2,"content":"忌煞有生有扶，或坐生旺之處，及有贊合六神，其專之意不可言也。柱中乃見用神，虛來生合情假，露形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"有氣，或落天中，雖旺亦無地面，情假力散，故自不若氣專者。若用神贊合，有扶有生，或力專生旺之位，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1250,"lineType":2,"content":"有生助之神，有情或有力，切要分曉。忌神煞神二者，雖在柱中作梗，力却自偏，嵗運兼有尅竊，自然柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1251,"lineType":2,"content":"停住不得，氣散而外馳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"缺用納音，全爲補氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608479232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"大撓造納音之法，隔八有用之具，如何竟為棄物？缺氣處仍要納音補借，如欠土納音，有土則補其不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1256,"lineType":2,"content":"休囚稍慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆妙意，身不能任，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1258,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣或多或重，自身無氣，豈能勝任。如隨其類逐其化，或從其象應其氣，不在此論。一説身不能任，如病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1259,"lineType":2,"content":"不能食，花不結實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"勢情充悦，發旺以時。象意空寒，幽棲度日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1261,"lineType":2,"content":"八字氣候、勢况、情思、體段，如人氣壯氣滿，似和煖喜悦之色，少能達時通濟，利物發明，或嵗運扶持，更何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1262,"lineType":2,"content":"言哉。若八字體制孤虛，氣象冷落，兼帶空亡休囚者，任有智術才勇，無所施展，嵗月空閒而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157850636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"成功之氣，變化歸尊，交互之神，往來俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1266,"lineType":2,"content":"成功變化，如壬水十二月，氣本殘廢，有木象支干引化，第一妙事。交互俱貴，如丁巳見辛亥，或庚寅己卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1267,"lineType":2,"content":"之類。地支雖衝不和處，二支互有閒神貴氣來往，其餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚更入空亡，時乖事退。旺相若兼生合，輻凑權行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1269,"lineType":2,"content":"凡休囚之物，本不好了，更入空亡，豈惟生不遇時，縱使乘時，事亦退散不濟。若五象旺相，到空猶可。金火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1270,"lineType":2,"content":"旺，入空却好。夫旺相之神，本自當時，若生若合，愈見精神權變，福能駢集，可行其志，去就皆不失序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"氣已過者欲退藏，翻宜墓絶之地；物方來者將進取，原","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"喜生旺之宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494486537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1275,"lineType":2,"content":"如三月甲木氣過，理合退藏，惟宜於墓絶之地，乃道合自然也。若臨生旺之鄉，反主乖戻。方來生旺者，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1276,"lineType":2,"content":"十二月甲木進氣，正月乙木進氣，将進方來，宜立生旺之地，為禍為福尤切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚有用，發越仍遲；旺相無情，爲惡最速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1278,"lineType":2,"content":"用神雖貴，有用生我助我，或又臨天月二徳，天乙之類。若不臨天時旺相，縱有用，發越遲遲。柱中雖帶旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1279,"lineType":2,"content":"相之神，與我無意，如半吉半凶，一至嵗運，只扶其凶煞，為禍最為猛速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"進神執權，至精至當。納音載貴，宜尅宜生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1281,"lineType":2,"content":"進神帶貴氣，柱中第一妙，引煞入内第一凶。貴氣柱中雖吉，情若未切，納音，宜來尅我生我，則方為有意，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1282,"lineType":2,"content":"以全其貴之美。若納音不生尅者，空負其貴，與我無統也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494519305"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神衝氣，透用凋枯；惡煞任權，本旬急切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1286,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁未或生夏月，得時之際，刑出丑中，辛癸透在柱中為用者，其福氣薄，為禍亦輕。惡煞旺相本凶，若同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1287,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰，一旬之内，禍速至重也。貴神本旬至吉至𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"金神得勢至凶，空亡遇衝必發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1289,"lineType":2,"content":"金神本凶，若無火鄉所制，又被别處扶起，或旺相，皆為得勢，至暴至剛，為凶特甚。空亡陷沒無用，乃棄物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1290,"lineType":2,"content":"也。遇衝神必然起發，即有用矣，如寅空見申之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"刃併元亡金滿局，全賴火神；旺相凶煞火焚空，須憑水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494502921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1295,"lineType":2,"content":"金乃殺害物命之象，滿局金氣，兼帶凶煞等神刑尅者，我不殺害他人，必被人所刺。無火制必驗火若焚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"炎之象盛者，此等多值火灾。况嵗運符合其氣，須藉水象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"木土氣託，以待發明。尅衝力停，未分勝負。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1298,"lineType":2,"content":"木非土則不能栽養，土非木則不能疎通，以待嵗運，扶其不足，煥發其氣，自然益堅。至於潤澤衝尅，有勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1299,"lineType":2,"content":"有負，力停則勝負未分，須觀其氣而消息之，方可㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"扶持生助，察轉養之神；戰鬬衝争，觀壞盡之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1301,"lineType":2,"content":"生助滔滔者㸔。轉養之神，何處為體用之基，為吉凶之兆而决之。戰鬬衝争，觀壞盡之氣，即此為閒退無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1302,"lineType":2,"content":"用之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494470153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"陰干取刃欲分明，支力當權防暗犯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"支力，一云貴力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1306,"lineType":2,"content":"陰干取刃，如丁巳見未，辛人見戌，為刃之類。支力當權，如未係貴神，或力重則合午，午衝子來犯未。又如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1307,"lineType":2,"content":"未有力重，能衝起丑字中癸巳之物出來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神挺立，物莫當前。惡煞滿盈，干無停處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"如一位之干，有天時至旺之氣，卓然柱中擅權，餘無牽綰者，其被尅之神，何敢現露，縱使藏伏，亦莫敢執","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1310,"lineType":2,"content":"事也。嵗干日干，遇滿局煞刃等惡，自家干主竟無住處，决主不祥，貧夭惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼中逢鬼無去就，衝而遇衝欠倚憑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1312,"lineType":2,"content":"尅害我者為鬼，倘鬼亦遇鬼來相害，輾轉傷尅，氣極逼我，若更無轉制促死之兆。支神被衝，干神貴氣，便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831556105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1315,"lineType":2,"content":"不安穏，奈何？衝神又遇衝激，我家更無倚賴之基象不立，物亦不成，非禍則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"併吞重尅皆成禍，二激雙衝總不祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1317,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲見二壬為重吞，見二庚為雙尅，柱中叠見衝神，或合處有刑有害，有尅有破，皆不祥之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1318,"lineType":1,"content":"五行務要均停，偏倚難能濟物。四柱全宜匹配，興衰恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"不成功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1320,"lineType":2,"content":"停均其説有五：一，日主用神，冲和相濟，彼此各有所賴，不偏。一損用神之氣者，有物以制之，不致作楚。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"干支上下字様，相承得所，無過不及。一死氣或對活物，黨寡不能勝黨衆。一欲變欲化，有妬有破，欲静欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1322,"lineType":2,"content":"安，有犯有激者。匹配其説有六。一衰神有用，須運扶衰者方可。一善惡雖能均配，㸔運扶何者以别吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694065143827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"一，雖有用神，一興一衰，偏枯不濟。一相安相濟，所應所求，各有倚賴。一旺欲成其物，一衰不可成全。或干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1326,"lineType":2,"content":"支各有所配，貴氣者或有所乖劣者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"平生福徳，不知化物連綿。次位來神，要識暗傷攔截。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1328,"lineType":2,"content":"支内有己乙辛丁之類，皆言七煞惡之，殊不知己土生乙金，乙金生辛水，辛水生丁木，續續不絶，况明露","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1329,"lineType":2,"content":"乎虛拱處，或有甲丙壬庚暗合完氣者，大富貴格。天干未來前一位，地支未來前一位，皆為凶惡，不可不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1330,"lineType":2,"content":"知。如乙見丙合辛，暗損及有刃類，子見丑，丑見寅，寅見卯之類，有刃有煞。咸池比肩，惡氣多端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"十干顧真氣相凌，七煞犯尅神極切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1332,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙酉見戊戌，即戊火傷乙金，又六害之墓，火發其旺金之氣，餘倣此。七煞犯尅，如原用乙木行酉運，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529683968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗衝損乙木，金局本壞，其乙木用神兼丑衝其虛未，將所藏之神碎壞倒地也。舉此一例，餘局細詳。  此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1336,"lineType":2,"content":"段止可言七煞逢衝者不吉，不可論金局壞乙木用神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"八字帶煞刑胎，意外須識。四印何干，乘氣類取其詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1338,"lineType":2,"content":"胎神所傳消息，各有異類，今人但總約十箇月之位，故無淺深，以致差池。一法，十箇月左右間，其所生日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1339,"lineType":2,"content":"辰對者是，如丙午日在何月節内，或十一月，或九月，遁而用之。若帶刑，主早妨父母。空陷衝刑，四煞最惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1340,"lineType":2,"content":"四印，古歌云：辰戌丑未為四印，戊己得之偏主信。甲乙若逢鄙且貪，丙丁或遇多貧病。庚辛格號母生兒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1341,"lineType":2,"content":"聚煞丑宫多短命。壬癸未詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"五行分布方隅，死水生金而異用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831588873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"謂火生寅敗卯旺午，金生巳敗午墓丑之類。如甲子人遇巳即為生金，生金尅甲，絶水生甲，及官火竊甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1346,"lineType":2,"content":"之類；遇卯即為死水，生甲，旺木同黨，敗火耗甲，位位各有所司，看其餘局次第扶抑而論之，餘干倣推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"一神閒停左右，傷官竊本以待時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1348,"lineType":2,"content":"閒停之神在左右者，即月時嵗干，多是不取用，故一向差慢，而至停囚長智，養病䘮身。或係傷官之神無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1349,"lineType":2,"content":"氣不係為事，忽嵗運助起，此等之神，耗我之氣，傷我之用，半真半假，其實則圉圉得勢，小人逢寵有權，留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1350,"lineType":2,"content":"此禍根，豈可忽哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"干神彼此相安，方爲禄備；地支來往衝激，不柰馬馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1352,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲人禄在寅，見壬寅則自家帶截路空亡，為僧道有福。庚寅為破禄，半吉半凶。又如辛禄在酉，見癸酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870511142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1355,"lineType":2,"content":"為火水相犯，丁酉為空亡貴。丁木受氣，辛水沐浴，主奸淫也。禄上遁干，號為真禄，着落何方有用其干見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1356,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙貴人，其貴上之明干，復坐貴禄。如丁人禄在午，遁至午得丙字，丙貴酉亥而逢辛酉，辛亥則辛貴復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1357,"lineType":2,"content":"見於午也，入格極品。此李虛中為天禄互貴。一馬不喜衝，衝則動，馬上干神乘貴者吉，馬上遁干有情者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1358,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。如丁丑人逢辛亥，是要貴處有用，馬上干神自帶凶煞，空亡者惡，來尅主體及用神者惡，或支神激烈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1359,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝轉轉，其馬豈得安休耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"傷盡官星，方知用禄；衝破禄位，始得用官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1361,"lineType":2,"content":"柱内有傷官之神，官星明被尅害，却有日禄者，用禄却穏當，不致兩用不歸一也。禄位如被破壞，却只用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1362,"lineType":2,"content":"官星為定體，盖貴用一端最妙，多則散了精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781661711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"禄位雖明化氣恐忌驛馬。既見日辰又重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1366,"lineType":2,"content":"官星，建禄等件，既明無破，為吉為福必矣。若體用成化，却於其位有妬有奪，化來不得者，為物不成，則亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1367,"lineType":2,"content":"苗而不秀，空貴無官，或有福而非財，積福厚者。驛馬本理於太嵗宫，要來乘用，若日宫又有馬出重叠者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1368,"lineType":2,"content":"反為賤局。一説日辰馬併嵗馬，雖重，馬甚有用，貴氣相安者愈好，再見則不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"記取。禄賔爲用，細觀馬將爲元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1370,"lineType":2,"content":"遁，禄上之干，名為禄賔。如無年禄，須㸔遁至禄官干神為用，主禄最切，却㸔日辰用為何神也。馬將亦如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1371,"lineType":2,"content":"禄法，譬如丁巳嵗丙日馬在亥，遁見辛為丙日之妻，主道途方外所娶，却分貴禄、財官、凶煞輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"用象契合，要防妬争；貴氣交通，切觀分奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781727247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"用神本與日干作合，有情有氣，得侣，或其明暗中有比肩，一争一妬，遇而不遇。用神，自家之神。争妬者一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1376,"lineType":2,"content":"體㫁法，嵗運同。凡貴氣專用則可兩處三處分用，便是衆人之物，不惟平生多起分争之訟，自家財産亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1377,"lineType":2,"content":"為比肩所擘，彼重我輕更甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"財官只倚日辰，亡刼須參太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1379,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰只取財官為用，最為親切。興衰旺絶，相生相尅，却與嵗家如何統攝？其行藏禍福極驗。亡刼二神，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1380,"lineType":2,"content":"年至重之惡煞也，須凖嵗君推參，各有進退吉凶。一、十六般所致行藏取舎之道，已録於前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"貴有等降明輕重，富有高低分厚薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1382,"lineType":2,"content":"察格局體制。如勢意猛烈，主本雄健，貴氣互換，往來凶煞，輔佐得所，不致氣滿無去就，第一義也。二、用神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781678095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1385,"lineType":2,"content":"至切至清，無破無壞，格局斤兩，相等而順。三、福神有情，化象得體。四、本等財官有用，運遇扶持不絶。五、所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1386,"lineType":2,"content":"喜之物，時上與運中扶持；所惡之物，時上與運中制馭。凶處兼有徳神，吉處每有煥發。一、大富不在財神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1387,"lineType":2,"content":"之輕重，大概亦有貴氣俱全者，不過㸔氣厚氣壯，但中間欠清純之象。二、精神有助，閒神頗多。日主有倚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1388,"lineType":2,"content":"印、食、財神三者至切。三、禄馬扶身，日主受氣，胞胎絶處，財宫有用，或遇生氣，但流逺聚象之氣不廣。四庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"財有拱或露，則要氣厚，得衝得刑，財印食神三位，一位有用日辰，但拘切自專，貴氣散漫，詳之各有高下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1390,"lineType":2,"content":"明矣。五帶刑尅，或尅我之物，係財星生旺之氣，或財神禄馬，貴人之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤而壽延，富貴而年夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"一、應用神尅戰無倚，又兼休囚無用，或臨死絶駁雜，獨身得中和之氣，運引而不偏。一、身臨胞胎死絶受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694065176595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1395,"lineType":2,"content":"氣之方，不帶福神行運，不能害者，或空亡破碎，元辰大耗，六害鬼墓，金神白虎，死氣刃煞，交併歸局，獨有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"一印綬，或一食神有力行運引而駁雜處不絶者，准前文。一、福神往來得勢，自身旺相，嵗運顯揚，太滿而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1397,"lineType":2,"content":"傾者，或欠轉生之神，或尅我處，竟無去就，或一空陷之物，刑衝我聚氣之所。一、本象與化象，皆得用神為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1398,"lineType":2,"content":"福，左右逢其源，其身却化而不化，根本不穏者。一、滿局貴氣，身弱不任，嵗運尅戰，日主准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"闉實亦由於火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1400,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土意，最良最實，氣象自然固聚，必是敦厚務本，利名安享，處世游優，却非駕空建功立業者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"流行俱藉於根源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1402,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡流年運限從容，不經風波成敗者，盖由根基元有得力貴氣，引行嵗運，贊助不壞，有所憑藉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831605257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明無非徳秀，晦懶總爲休囚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"徳秀如申子辰月，壬癸為徳，丙辛為秀，帶此多是文業通達，聰明曉事之人，餘局例此。休囚廢死者，天時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1407,"lineType":2,"content":"也。死敗墓絶者，五行也。如滿局俱帶此等氣數，一生謀望無成，退悔藏拙，若兼孤氣出，俗作林泉人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"偏氣俱强而鄙俗，本源失托則漂流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"如八字純陰純陽，柱中因欠合神財宫等貴，用神既偏且强，又能刑出衝飛之物來者，皆為偏氣所致，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1410,"lineType":2,"content":"豪亦俗，非俊秀才噐矣。日主象則無黨可就，氣則無貴可乘，柱中多係閒神慢煞，兼有刑尅衝竊，散漫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，此等懶散馳逐，多謀少立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"氣如猛烈，害物傷人；象若純和，無操無縱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781710863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"勢當天時之氣，勇猛剛强。若更帶金神白虎刃煞刑害之神，凶則為强盗刼掠，善則屠儈活計，終亦殺人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1416,"lineType":2,"content":"害物，恐亦被人殺戮也。臨事有㫁，機變通利，皆由凶煞之神不滯不塞，輔佐用神，有以使之然也。若柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1417,"lineType":2,"content":"象數純和柔善，氣，實則無綱常倫序之能，雖有用神，亦難也矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"軒昂呼應，原憑刃煞之威；齷齪財豐，盡帶庫墓之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"有貴氣，無刃煞輔佐，不獨臨事無威勇，作為殊欠相應合也。有此刃煞扶貴，必能做事立業，果决有㫁，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1420,"lineType":2,"content":"人名目卑微，却發財禄，乃庫基中雜氣，財官印綬親厚，有益於日主。况嵗運扶合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"身强露刃，翻宜聚斂營營；干合多偏，倒亂精神渺渺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1422,"lineType":2,"content":"身强力健，柱中暗有財源之意，若見刃露，本為刼財，但我力既專，財神有情，反宜刃露，盖我能執奪，歸斂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608544768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"其物也。此等格調，慳吝幹蠱，善能聚財，若柱中嵗運，有刃旺之地，未敢如此議㫁，須别詳之。干合多偏，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1426,"lineType":2,"content":"乙見三庚二庚合者，豈惟氣不得中，亦自偏枯倒亂，縱化得成象，亦未成全美，不過三姓同居，兩姓合活，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"接李換桃人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"獨爲煞布衆辰，虛張聲勢；一種貴由三處，分散英靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"煞本不聚，若只一位之煞，布向諸處，力自輕疏，不至謀多遂少，有口無心，過望大節，力小任重。一件貴氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1430,"lineType":2,"content":"精專為竒，若二三處皆有，如密雲不雨，秀而不實，或空貴無官，多學少成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"平頭帶來針刃，豈無傷殘；勾絞併至亡刼，寜惟狡猾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1432,"lineType":2,"content":"平頭乃甲丙丁等字様。引懸針羊刃，刑害日辰。一云日中帶煞帶華盖，主妻先嫁人，或殘疾，或愚鈍。一云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157916172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1435,"lineType":2,"content":"率因事而結婚，或有貌必淫，如己人未日，或己亥己卯、己未。一云日時羊刃，爲貼身刃，妻有生離死别。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1436,"lineType":2,"content":"云互換懸針，主帶疾及官刑，併惡煞自刑立見，女人亦然。勾絞二神，主狡猾破敗，吉則立威，若臨亡刼必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1437,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，况不和於日主者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"財居庫地，身入衰鄉，性能鄙吝，氣亦猥慵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1439,"lineType":2,"content":"財神遇庫閑藏，既欠刑衝開激，况身弱者，此等之人，度量慳鄙，噐宇少豁達也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"木遇學堂，火臨生地，文既精華，志尤倨傲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1441,"lineType":2,"content":"木火文明之象，居生旺之位，主文學疏通，才能雄健。但木火炎上之氣，為人不顧細節，不能屈下，倨傲驕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1442,"lineType":2,"content":"忽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157899788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"播徳望之聲名，敏智謀之才畧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1446,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣有助，干有力，天月徳辰及天乙互換來往，主聰明雅望，兼藉空亡刑衝得用，准上文。煞刃扶貴象，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1447,"lineType":2,"content":"制伏得中，日干可以馭伏，准上文。又云：水帶貴氣，有扶助，有隄防，才畧機變，智謀過人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"財源拘局，街頭庫店經營；竊氣無憑，化外江湖奔走。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1449,"lineType":2,"content":"格局不廣，噐宇不充，但有財源助身，一二支伶俐生扶，而局於純粹之噐，兼庫神得用，宅神有情者，准上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1450,"lineType":2,"content":"文。又云食神或印，此例同㫁。凡泄氣之神，汗漫滔滔之勢，逺而有力，聚而無依，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"江湖泛泛兮風飡雨宿，羅網濛濛兮利鎖名韁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1452,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子為江湖，若係財官禄馬用神，其氣泛溢者，多致道途生計。披星帶月，其水泛泛，其馬刑衝方㫁。辰巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529749504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1455,"lineType":2,"content":"為地網，戌亥為天羅，全者用神，其上失地，五氣不能成象，則利名碌碌無成。如塵埃所罩，昏霧所迷。嵗運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1456,"lineType":2,"content":"併臨，仍與日干尅害者，夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"水火動摇，是非林裏。立身木金和恊，義禮門庭，發財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1458,"lineType":2,"content":"水火乃人間之動物，犯此格，多惹是非唇吻。凡立身為事，每於閙裡出頭，鬬喋之中着脚。若吉則有决䇿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1459,"lineType":2,"content":"之機，凶則有不雅之號。金木無偏倚，氣和得中，陰陽相配相濟者，必務本實。我若尅彼，專當獲道義之財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1460,"lineType":2,"content":"若交錯無情，主被客凌者，主不義人損我無意中之財，或被不義事寃屈折辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬。得我尅他生，盡發外邦之禄；空亡有物，明氣見，每","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"膺無意之名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435116071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1465,"lineType":2,"content":"遇馬上之干，日主能尅，或馬位有物生我者，多是逺方外財發越，或出外於邉境得財禄，空亡為凶敗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1466,"lineType":2,"content":"所。若有喜象集來，如金火喜空乘旺，爲官貴等神，有情者合此格局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖食禄，家計貧寒，庫有餘財，名目卑賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1468,"lineType":2,"content":"八字體段輕清，官神乘貴，地支或破其象，休廢其財，却又入死絶等處，不帶墓庫宅神之貴，宅神仍衝破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1469,"lineType":2,"content":"者，准上文。貴氣落空亡，用神入死敗處，仍無生意。其咸池沐浴，白虎空亡，却有拱䕶柱中，惟財庫或財神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1470,"lineType":2,"content":"專旺輔日，主有情尅助者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗望闕門，當近朝堂之職；氣衝第宅，難依祖業之基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1472,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗對為闕門，有拱入格，决主食禄職任，皆近於朝堂要路之處。嵗前第五位若是被衝，更與日主非貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529765888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1475,"lineType":2,"content":"氣生扶綂攝者，决主祖上基業離破，不能居住。若乘官符並亡神，主為官㫁沒抄封，犯破碎刼刃，毁售必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1476,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"二位不宜亡刼，拆屋售田；四仲若犯咸池，貪財美貌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1478,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗前第五位為命宅，後第五位為禄宅，命宅為第宅家舎，禄宅為田庄邱墓。若帶亡刼，主平生愛費財造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1479,"lineType":2,"content":"屋置田，却主破壞，况與日家刑衝害刼破尅乎。子午卯酉全，古謂遍野桃花，又名亷貞沐浴，又為暴敗桃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1480,"lineType":2,"content":"花，帶此主愛風流藝術，性巧情急，是非中立身，與日刑衝尅竊方准，忌水主淫，兼貴煞輕重言之。咸池𦂳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1481,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"馬上空亡，每遇異路之財帛；天中禄位，常招憎號之聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608593920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1486,"lineType":2,"content":"馬上遁干得用，遇馬上明干助我，或作財元，或馬坐財生旺之地，却坐空亡有意多外方出入，獲外方財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1487,"lineType":2,"content":"禄，或常招别門，無心利禄。異路言非本等之財也。天中即空亡帶禄，若衰敗者，准上文加白虎在日𦂳切，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1488,"lineType":2,"content":"或招人傳之惡名，况水火象并咸池桃花乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉好遷移門户，巳午當感夢生胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1490,"lineType":2,"content":"犯卯酉字，在日時，好粧飾堂亭，遷改門户，帶馬則常移居止。胎時加臨巳午，帶年禄和諧其日主者，主應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1491,"lineType":2,"content":"父母，得夢生産。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"旺刃不兼餘煞，偏好異端；亡刼更引他神，只圖豪飲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608577536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1495,"lineType":2,"content":"旺氣羊刃，别無餘煞。者，剛亷正直武勇，愛籠養打捕，起扮社火之類，帶學堂官貴，别詳亡神刼煞。羊刄多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1496,"lineType":2,"content":"聚，更與日不和恊，狼飡鯨飲，逐日醉飽，一任風波，落魄無成矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花簪主恣風情，破碎朝元宜落魄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1498,"lineType":2,"content":"桃花簪主，如卯人見寅午戌，酉人見申子辰之類，又謂倒揷桃花，為人風流倜儻，却有賢而不賢也。與日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1499,"lineType":2,"content":"尅竊，方准破碎朝元，如酉人見寅申巳亥，丑人見辰戌丑未之類，亦謂面頭破碎。尅竊刑害日辰，主狡猾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1500,"lineType":2,"content":"命夭，輕則不能起發而貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"官符落在天中，語多妄誕；空亡却臨天乙，性好謳吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1502,"lineType":2,"content":"官符即亡神也，在空亡中，與日尅竊。天乙貴人在空亡中，與日尅竊，各准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781760015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"纔傷用氣，抱怨嗟呼。重駕身强，妄爲狂蕩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1506,"lineType":2,"content":"用神當生，縱無傷動，倘若嵗運來尅，必須得意，中反成失意，故嗟呼生怨矣。凡身旺之人，即如飲酒醉眩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1507,"lineType":2,"content":"者，欲其無狂，不可得也。或又遇嵗運重駕氣强，自然所為淫蕩狂妄，兼破財産家業，胡做胡為。柱有馭制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1508,"lineType":2,"content":"有倚托，别詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎兼刃，罵殺時人。華葢自墓，享於清福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1510,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎同刃，乃白虎與飛刃羊刃同宫，與日刑衝，尅竊者如此。一云若在日時上尅年者，娶妻鶻突，不然妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1511,"lineType":2,"content":"有異症，因服訟促逼結親則可，其妻亦愛訟人也。華盖自墓若自生旺，又遇嵗運與日和合成局，極受清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1512,"lineType":2,"content":"高之福，否則為僧道九流。如庚辰不能自墓，只是村巫，或為粗魯手作人。一云華盖帶墓有氣，主福夀，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435132455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1515,"lineType":2,"content":"不至封爵之貴，或為僧道名望人，若帶鬼咸池，非藝人即村巫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"禄命二神相激，鼓舞作爲貴煞，四位相承，聚歸取用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1517,"lineType":2,"content":"前法。禄命二宅若犯激作刑衝尅害，看吉凶之意何如，與日不和，應驗如此。盖禄命二神實係衝命，左鼓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1518,"lineType":2,"content":"右舞之氣使然也。或貴或煞，二重三重兼併一辰上者。况柱中四位，各有吉凶之神，要分聚在何位最多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1519,"lineType":2,"content":"以較長短。寅申巳亥無長生則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"水火之象，輕清則文章異術，刑衝則道徳禪門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"水火乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"之神，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1521,"lineType":2,"content":"之造化。其中氣清則文章魁衆，輕則術業異常，空則仙風異質，刑則道法鬼符，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1522,"lineType":2,"content":"尅則禪宗空寂，野衲宿縁，參究覺悟。專論日辰格象輕重而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529782272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"金土之源，氣老則財庫樓臺，殘嫩則經商手藝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1526,"lineType":2,"content":"金土之義，有以賤生貴之功，氣老則成就其物，盖宜於富藏，墻垣第宅莊營之壯觀，由此而致也。或衰氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1527,"lineType":2,"content":"殘絶，或初新氣嫩，若非經商買賣，則手藝工作之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢墓神，天月徳合，泉石家風，休囚日徳，死絶敗生，塵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"埃庶士，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1530,"lineType":2,"content":"華盖墓神，天月徳合，三件循環於柱中者，必有水邉石上宿縁，辦道求仙至意。日徳若休廢，虚有其徳名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1531,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。况又干音有死敗等位，惡氣空亡來生助者，不過碌碌一寒士爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"十惡大敗。若真貴為將，賤為冦，囚死空亡若聚生者道，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608610304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"衰者僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1536,"lineType":2,"content":"十惡以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1536,"lineType":2,"content":"道藏經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1536,"lineType":2,"content":"所載為准。貴氣相扶，清厚入格，必掌兵權；若凶煞凑集，交併柱中，戰害用神，身主則凶。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"主用神，當休廢之時，落空亡，兼為孤寡。六害若臨長生臨官旺地，則爲黄冠；若處敗絶墓死之方，則為緇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1538,"lineType":2,"content":"衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡權重，却害六親，刼寡雖孤，喜全三貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1540,"lineType":2,"content":"辰為天罡，戌為天魁，最有權威力量，但孤尅之氣太重，未免妨害六親。刼煞寡宿，若帶長生，貴人有禄，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1541,"lineType":2,"content":"三件之福氣也，與日和恊，必主富貴。無此三件，縱發不久而貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"吞啖勢繁，非偏房定乏乳哺。孤寡來併由異姓，假合同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410438665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"居，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1546,"lineType":2,"content":"吞啖乃倒食之神，倘多有力有勢有權，或臨生旺之鄉太切，准上文。孤寡六害同併，却有印綬食神，一有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1547,"lineType":2,"content":"用者，仍見宅神衝破，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1548,"lineType":1,"content":"重拜雙生。己亥帶支干，同類巫醫酒色亡刼犯咸池貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1550,"lineType":2,"content":"命帶己亥二位，又有别支别干，一類同者，有二三位者，如甲見甲，子見子，必是雙生，或重拜父母，須是干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1551,"lineType":2,"content":"支俱有相同方的，更刼孤亦然。師巫藥術、牙儈等輩，仍分輕重高下，皆亡神咸池二位主領，兼羊刃破碎、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1552,"lineType":2,"content":"墓鬼、白虎之類者。狂妄詭詐，迷花戀酒，九流不才之人。若貴人徳神、財官生旺者，庶㡬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435148839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離交㑹，老醉秦樓，象類清幽，㓜登仙府，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"子午上有干神鈎合，如壬子戊午之類，戊合子癸，壬合午丁，或丁合壬，癸合戊，水火有情，至老迷戀，清則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1557,"lineType":2,"content":"風流，濁則卑賤。五行之氣，至清成象，况引於幽潔之地。貴神歸一不雜，氣純清逺，别無死絶等件惡神相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1558,"lineType":2,"content":"犯，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"論文學業特精英，長生徳秀。殢酒惜花偏落魄，身旺咸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"池，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1561,"lineType":2,"content":"長生帝旺，四貴等處，徳秀二神，文學才能，藝術特達，精專出類，㧞萃人也。殢酒惜花日干旺於咸池之上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1562,"lineType":2,"content":"一也。本身自旺，受沐浴之神尅者，二也。本身太旺，沐浴更多，福氣散漫不聚，三也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709600275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"妻遇比肩旺奪，非是良人，財因沐浴强争，難辭淫濁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1566,"lineType":2,"content":"妻干或隠或顯，而切切遇比肩，相近相親，其位被占奪。又或比肩乘旺，其妻必與外人私通，不然娶婢妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1567,"lineType":2,"content":"娼妓為婚，免此醜。五行敗處為沐浴，又名桃花咸池煞，一例同㫁。其神若來，乘勢争財，或財立其上，被他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1568,"lineType":2,"content":"神所竊戰者，我身兼與用神之氣，不聚不斂，精神散漫，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"娶婚却因服訟。類明六干生子欲别賢愚，體有五法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1570,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰，丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、丁未、戊申、辛酉、壬戌、癸亥，犯此日，多因孝服、官訟二事，臨逼結","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1571,"lineType":2,"content":"婚。或成親百日内决，主一家忽招訟服。或主無外家力，舅氏不諧。或無外家，或兩重父母，或無妻財，或女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1572,"lineType":2,"content":"命兩重，翁姑半真半假。帶合神桃花，花燭不明，或非良婦，或殘房入舎。此六干柱中，多者尤𦂳尤濫，即陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157998092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1575,"lineType":2,"content":"錯陽差也。帶桃花在帝旺，多惹婦人官訟，或豪家亦因妻黨婢妾致争，否則兒女官司也。别子賢愚五法：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1576,"lineType":2,"content":"一、以妻生而尅我者為子，男以偏官為子，女以正官為子。一云女以我生為子，引至時上，逢生旺則好，仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1577,"lineType":2,"content":"以餘神㑹合有情方貴。一云我與妻同化者，如甲人以土為子，引至時上考究。一、化氣所生者為子，如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1578,"lineType":2,"content":"人以金為子，引至時上取用。一、我之本氣所生者即子，如甲人火為子，引至時上詳究。一、但是偏官正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1579,"lineType":2,"content":"有情，引至時上，化得成象即好。子納音長生之氣，贊助妙甚。一云如以我生為子類，以水一火二木三金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1580,"lineType":2,"content":"四土五取之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"惡攢時日，輕則子抝妻愚，重則空房隻影。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1582,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼孤寡三刑，若三煞併而有救者，時上子多不孝，日上妻愚拙或不和。若重犯力猛無救，孤獨貧寒，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410471433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1585,"lineType":2,"content":"生自守空房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"刃帶墓刑，吉而夀彌福厚，凶而破㡌單衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1587,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃飛刃犯墓刑二位，須有華盖始吉，及丑未干頭貴者，未有不享福也，與日宜和。若無華盖，帶空亡死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1588,"lineType":2,"content":"絶孤寒破敗人也，與日不和亦如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"日犯惡神有助，再婚女妻，時臨凶煞仍空，須招義子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1590,"lineType":2,"content":"日犯年家亡刼，大敗破碎，臨官帝旺者尅妻，却有干音生助日主，必是再娶少年室女，或㓜妾為妻。若帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1591,"lineType":2,"content":"禄貴贊助者，貌美賢能。一云若年之禄馬貴食六合，在日不獨妻秀，更能掌財。時上帶凶煞落空亡，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1592,"lineType":2,"content":"無子。若生助食神，或日去衝尅者，必是螟蛉之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781792783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"時日咸池帶煞，父命惡亡。休囚大敗臨空，妻家無宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1596,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池在日時為嵗煞，主父惡死，更加惡煞無疑，如金主刀兵，火主火厄，水主水厄，土主瘟疫，木主枷杖。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1597,"lineType":2,"content":"五象推之。一云帶咸池，若旺犯華盖破碎，及陰錯陽差，因妻醜辱，或離異。若貴豪之家，妻父母兄弟親屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1598,"lineType":2,"content":"内亂。一云：咸池羊刃，多算多能，亦有宿疾互換，在日時𦂳切日，主宅神陷妻之氣，兼的煞十惡大敗之日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1599,"lineType":2,"content":"休廢又落空亡，如甲寅旬癸禄居子，為空神，主妻家無片瓦根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"胎神尅竊横亡，忌衝局中之字；破碎空孤離祖，因犯禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"後之神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1602,"lineType":2,"content":"胎神白虎煞也，水午金卯之類，衝局中字。如申子辰支，係水命，怕午字之胎神白虎，來尅竊日主，併用神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672090988571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1605,"lineType":2,"content":"主血光横死。以五象推之，禄後一辰，若係空亡孤寡破碎等煞，定主出祖旺相，别立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"支隔合衝二方，此格多應自縊。合兼河井兩位，犯者無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"不溺亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1608,"lineType":2,"content":"自縊煞乃戌人巳、巳人戌之例。若帶金神、白虎、亡刼、鬼墓、空亡、官符、大耗，刃煞領其死絶之地，來尅其身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1609,"lineType":2,"content":"廢其用神，犯其太嵗，刑其大運，准上文。丙子旺水，癸未東井，癸丑三河，帶咸池金神、羊刃，亡神多主死於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1610,"lineType":2,"content":"水中。一云若帶亡神，起端因花酒惹事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"目瞶耳盲，用神䧟切，而死敗尅身；腰駝足跛，福氣衰頽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"而刃煞刑主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091004955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1615,"lineType":2,"content":"用神，被死敗等物尅竊，又臨亡刼、空亡、大耗諸煞尅竊身者，准上文。貴氣休囚、勾絞、空亡、大耗，無所倚托，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1616,"lineType":2,"content":"死絶之氣，出現沉淪，旺鄉之吉，刃煞仍刑我日主者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼嘯。應知惡夭本虧，非止貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1618,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼嘯如甲人遇庚，庚遇丙，轉轉相尅之類，有辛合其丙，方可貪合忘尅，如無辛来合，不可言甲去生丙。本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1619,"lineType":2,"content":"虧乃兇神作黨，尅日家之氣，害年之干，所以貧難，少亡不夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"天地具包藏之徳，風雷遥激烈之聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1621,"lineType":2,"content":"申亥二字明有力量，酉戌用神得所，正合此格。一云：申亥不露支神，虚夾二位有貴氣者，體局不凡。卯巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1622,"lineType":2,"content":"二位内有貴氣，柱中虛拱，嵗運對衝空處，必能變化發越。一云：拱夾穏處，又恐刑衝太迫，走了貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709616659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"拱將拱座并拱印，必是貴人；顧子顧母尤顧身，自非俗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1627,"lineType":2,"content":"拱將謂本支三合，如子人見申辰之例。拱座謂對宫，如子人即午之例。拱印謂印綬正位，如甲人子丑之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1628,"lineType":2,"content":"例。一説印乃庫也，又云印即干庫兼。若財官貴氣有用，或財官生旺之鄉，皆富貴造化，生我者為母，我生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"者為子，兼自身三位俱無損壞，往來顧盻有福益者，為有福人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"三位竒寳用官神，流芳英烈。四干天乙臨華葢，曠世清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1632,"lineType":2,"content":"時座三合，謂之竒寳。若官星居上，無破無忌，世代不絶，芳名勲業人也。古法不獨論嵗日之干乘天乙之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781809167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1635,"lineType":2,"content":"貴為吉，月時干有貴人乘者更妙，況臨本命華盖，生平不止無凶，亦清高竒貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"四面宣明旺相，内廷食禄。二煞若臨夾拱，沙塞揚威。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1637,"lineType":2,"content":"青龍元武、朱雀勾陳，為四面干禄歸元，各占方位旺相。如甲乙臨寅卯為青龍，丙丁臨巳午為朱雀之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1638,"lineType":2,"content":"准上文。亡神刼煞，二位俱空閒，而却各有拱夾者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"金水文華而㧞萃，土金阜富以成高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1640,"lineType":2,"content":"金水二象若清，無其餘之氣，混濁其源者，文采英華，出類之格。金土相生，若各無偏倚，得中和之氣者，似","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1641,"lineType":2,"content":"物漸長，生意益高。如此之象，當作富貴之格。或貴氣和恊，亦主功名食禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"榮耀者，木火有發源；清貴者，水木多順序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694065209363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1645,"lineType":2,"content":"木火易於煥發，有來處根源，柱中生意，或引嵗運，故能扶引而榮耀。所以人不知其有根氣，但知運上木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1646,"lineType":2,"content":"火透發也。水木清竒，若其氣不偏倚，順扶生旺帶貴者，必為翰苑清要，或臺諫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"登金歩玉，貴人頭上帶官星。負笈挑簦，學堂館中逢驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙頭上有官星顯露，謂之官星坐貴主貴。學堂乃日主生旺之位，學館為官星生旺之方，臨官之位，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1650,"lineType":2,"content":"同取用。遇驛馬在中，無甚貴氣者，空有才學無成，即入仕途，亦多奔走道路，落空亡更甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"翰苑標名，定禀乾坤瑞氣；薇垣秉政，應拱子午端門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1652,"lineType":2,"content":"寅巳二位有力，能合亥申乾坤。又有三合拱者，子辰能拱申，卯未能拱亥，若無雜申亥乘其貴氣，必為出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410520585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1655,"lineType":2,"content":"羣之造矣。子午一位或有正拱，或有三合外拱，如有貴氣集上，勲業名家，人所未及。丑亥拱子、未巳拱午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1656,"lineType":2,"content":"為正。申辰拱子、寅戌拱午，為外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡纔逢夾貴。風憲提刑，龍虎得以專職；玉堂拜相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1658,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌二位逢夾貴為風憲提刑者，謂有威權振作也。如壬癸逢巳卯拱辰，丙丁逢酉亥拱戌是也。又明見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"魁罡重集貴氣，同前㫁。辰寅二位，若遇正拱外拱，有貴氣吉神聚其上者，妙合此格。或見寅辰得氣集貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1660,"lineType":2,"content":"旺相扶持，無衝刑尅害，仍得卯處有吉者，同前㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽偏用貴崇，奮極品之尊；卯酉正門權輔，領外藩之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709633043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1665,"lineType":2,"content":"偏陰偏陽，其氣多是奮發，風飛雷厲。貴氣若專旺相力重，驟進極品者多。盖偏氣好争，挺然不配雄豪力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1666,"lineType":2,"content":"大。偏官易於起發，但是退速，或非命爾。若正官則穏，隨分遷擢，無生殺之權。卯酉乃日月出入之門户，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1667,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣拱夾得用者，合此。或明見此二位用神集福，有力無破者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗駕禄馬帶財官，英雄超邁；貴局日時乘徳秀，才業峥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"嶸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1670,"lineType":2,"content":"凡太嵗禄馬二位，宜係日主，財官居上，豈非英雄超邁。凡貴人局在日時，見徳秀二氣者，合主文章才業","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"大噐，秀㧞英傑之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"用拙而運扶，枯鱗濟水；用强而運拙，曲港行舟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608643072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"用神力慳，或有氣而被尅竊，或隠藏而無衝合，鈍而不利，運上却引生扶之氣，悠然暢意矣。用神或有力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1676,"lineType":2,"content":"或得時，或情合，若運中阻壞其氣者，東碍西撞，不能順駕，縱有一時風便，其柰何也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"運以支重為基，嵗以干重乘氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"運之支神太過之物則宜抑之，不及之物則宜扶之，須要與當生支神貫穿，㸔其本末乖順何如。若只詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1679,"lineType":2,"content":"用神輕重扶抑者，亦未善。又論生氣尅氣，運支至重，次觀運干戰鬬和諧何似，綂何柱中之物有情而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"方吉。流年與太嵗干神闗係最𦂳切，一年萬神吉凶之主。日尅嵗則災，合則晦，若有化有情，則有好事。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1681,"lineType":2,"content":"驗灾福遲速，仍察運中相攝如何，須兼用嵗支刑衝破害上言，無偏則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"運馳行色用，分何弱與何强；嵗攝兵權，勢持情急，而情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091021339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"如日為身，貴為用，二者難以偏廢。日主為體，貴氣為用，俱欲中和。一説用神貴氣，如登程行李噐物粮草","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1687,"lineType":2,"content":"等件，運即住脚公廨舘宇所泊之所。五氣貴煞何者？引彼地理所宜，或順以參考其否㤗之兆。吉凶二象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1688,"lineType":2,"content":"運元未萌，非嵗則不能激揚其兆。惟嵗君最嚴最切，至威至重，持握特急，勢來則如戰陣鬬敵，迅速險大，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1689,"lineType":2,"content":"難以卒然救應議擬也。雖鐵闗金鎻，其能拒哉？亦有貴氣為凶，抑惡揚善，乘機凑濟，莫測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴。運欲顯揚，少壯宜兼旺地。凶煞須從沉昧，老人更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"喜衰鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"一胞胎養，沐長生冠帶之地。二十嵗宜行臨官帝旺之運，陽氣强盛。三四十嵗宜行衰病墓絶之運，天癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435181607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1695,"lineType":2,"content":"枯竭。五六十嵗宜行其中合可之義，則造化取舎之道，通變為言者也。運中少壯合體，固宜揚其貴禄。凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"神運欲沉淹，老者宜行死絶等運，仍不要與日主用神表裡生意者，誠為福運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"運氣發源力穏，方易成功；時干化象求情，行當領用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1698,"lineType":2,"content":"行運究考，的驗福禍，亦是易事，當逐官消息，審其來意。如運之發源在年月日時上空衝死敗之地，縱發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1699,"lineType":2,"content":"不久，發源在穏實住處，可耐患難，可享富貴，福澤悠逺也。行運之法，取時干之化象者，有體象化象二意，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"二者得侣，有情有類，為象成用，或行至運中扶持，或旋造成其噐，第一妙事，乃虛中家傳之秘，有此極論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"引用餘神之氣，最切宜取用生尅强弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"蜚黄騰踏，運開一路官星；豹變興隆，年統平生財氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410536969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中帶官星，不若運運統攝，官神得意，歩歩榮耀。八字中有財不旺，雖見無情，行運雖至生旺之處，仍未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"奮發，盖氣或死絶，或滯塞，嵗乃尊嚴之君，吉凶神煞之主。流年或領財元，或生扶財象，或激開財庫，或遥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1707,"lineType":2,"content":"合飛衝生旺之所，或拱夾暗包財神禄馬貴人之宫，其財之旺，由此嵗君統繫，豹變勃然興發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"運凌身弱而適扶用神，運變身强而抑其福氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"當生身旺，或比肩大繁，用神怯弱者，宜凌廢其身之氣，適扶我之用神，反是則不祥矣。當生本體衰弱，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"神太過，身不勝任，又或錯亂不能歸一，所喜如是，反是則乖。盖當生本末體用相稱，運扶身太過，或困其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"用神，亦不中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗或運符吉罔凶，嵗或運昧善縱惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410553353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1715,"lineType":2,"content":"或當生凶煞力重，吉神力輕，財官勢況散漫，嵗運符合福神而抑凶氣者有之。當生吉神力重，凶煞氣薄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗運失紀綱制馭之道，或至於縱容惡煞，沉昧衆善者有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井奥訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃安東杜謙所著，其間幽趣妙象數見，而用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"藏氣類，從無立有，倒飛暗合，得一分三，脱胎換骨，入聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"超凡，誠非易事。欲窮其絶處逢生，要識其旺而退藏。噐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"滿必傾，物過則損。黨盛則隨類，氣衰則托情。用不用，真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"假宜辨；變不變象類先分。故氣禀有厚薄焉，有清濁焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"有高卑焉，有晦明焉，萬緒萬端，千變千化。氣有生尅究","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709649427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"竟，盡燭理外之理，物有造化活法，極參元中之元，誠得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚中餘學一派之正傳也。世之不得覩是書者多矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"予故表而出之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1727,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529815040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"卷十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
