{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣，生五行，統三才，周萬物。發乾坤之妙用，剖陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"之樞機。在乎推四方，分其貴賤，得其中道八字一定榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"枯。是以強眀其生尅制化、清濁貴賤、夀夭賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":8,"content":"此原造化之始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844627468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"金頼土生，土多金埋；土頼火生，火多土焦；火頼木生，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"多火熾；木頼水生，水多木漂；水頼金生，金多水濁。金能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"生水，水多金沉；水能生木，木盛水縮；木能生火，火多木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"㷊；火能生土，土多火晦；土能生金，金多土變；金能尅木，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"堅金缺；木能尅土，土重木折；土能尅水，水多土流；水能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"尅火，火炎水熱；火能尅金，金多火熄。金衰遇火，必見銷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"鎔；火弱逢水，必為熄滅；水弱逢土，必為淤塞。土衰遇木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"必遭傾䧟；木弱逢金，必為砍折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776931909684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言太過不及，各有其害。如此見五行四柱，不可不中和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"強金得水方挫其鋒，強水得木方泄其勢，強木得火方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"化其頑，強火得土方止其熖，強土得金方制其害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言五行尅制要得中和，而大過不及胥失之矣。所以照破上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"理貫人融者，妙其幽，察其顯也。其為體也，深能通變，究","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"其元㣲；其為用也，論其輕重，原有原無。天理賦來，吉㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"動静，人生分定，否泰盈虧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":32,"lineType":2,"content":"以上通論干支隂陽生尅制化之中，體幽用顯，輕重有無，而吉㓙動静，否泰盈虧，皆自此而生之也。妙在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776931876916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":35,"lineType":2,"content":"識其通變，究其元㣲，由顯而幽，斯得其理。以下則詳言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無刃不威，刃無煞不顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"煞乃尅我，刃乃劫我，命中之最㓙者肯言煞刃，其知所重者歟！賦云刃為兵器，無煞難存；煞為軍令，無刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"不尊。刃煞雙顯，威鎮乾坤是也。徐大昇因見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_1","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"繼善","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"二萹不足以盡人之命，故復撰此賦，所以補其未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"備也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"權刃雙顯均停，位至王侯；刃煞輕重無制，身為胥吏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"言煞刃相停者極貴，不相停者極賤。刃煞停不停，而貴賤之相懸如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"生平富而且貴；煞重身柔，中途忽死或危運扶干旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899507200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"既不相停，不如從煞。能從者，必煞重身柔而後可從，不然不能從也。既從煞，只以煞論，不可再遇身旺相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"敵，敵則反生禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"處身僧道之首，用煞反輕；受職臺諫之除，偏官得地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞為權星，又為孤星，身煞兩強，七煞有制。身弱從煞皆貴，然多為臺諫之官。若身旺煞輕，更入清竒，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"為僧道之首矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知大貴者用財而不用官，當權者用煞而不用印。印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"賴煞生，官因財旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"用財不用官，財生官也。用煞不用印，煞生印也。故云印頼煞生。官因財旺，非不用印用官，而專用財煞，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444215323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"官印在其中矣。印頼二句，𦂳本上文，四句自發眀之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"五行消息，元理可知，四柱推眀，用神可見。食居先，煞居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"後，功名兩全；酉破卯，卯破午，財官雙美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"人之八字，全㸔用神。如上用煞、用刃、用財，而不用官用印，其理甚元，在人消息之耳。論煞當要刃，無刃要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"有制，煞強有制皆為貴。論煞主名，食主利，故曰功名兩全。酉破卯，卯破午，亦食前煞後之意。酉以卯為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"午為煞，財煞兼有，故主財官两美。然所以相破者，以其相尅也，必四正相破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"享福五行，歸禄眉夀，八字相停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":62,"lineType":2,"content":"此舉命中最要者言之。要歸禄，要相停，不可死絶偏黨。享福屬歸禄，眉夀屬相停，義各有所取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889203731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"晦火無光於稼穡，盜木多困於丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":66,"lineType":2,"content":"此以下正言不歸禄，不相停，故不得享福、眉夀。土掩火光。土賴木疎，木本生火，火多則反盜氣，見不中和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"火虚有熖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"火怕晦，虚則有𦦨不晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"金實無聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":71,"lineType":2,"content":"金要火無，火煉則不成器，實何以發聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮者活木，土重金埋者陽金。水盛則危，火眀則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899523584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":76,"lineType":2,"content":"此又細分五行不相停而有隂陽之别。見五行不可太過。如水泛則木浮，在乙木則怕，甲木則否。土重金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"埋，在庚金則畏，辛金則否。以乙木死於亥，甲木生於亥。庚金出土之金，所以生己；辛金帶水之金，所以生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":78,"lineType":2,"content":"子。水盛則泛濫，故危。火明則煨燼，故滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"陽金得煉太過，變革奔波；隂木歸垣失令，終為身弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"金實無聲。煉過變革，歸禄享福。失令身弱，見要中和。陽金土重則埋。怕煉太過，是無土也。隂木失令則弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"縱是歸垣，亦損夀也。此夲上文活木陽金而言。又不可無水，土生養也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"土厚而掩火無光，水盛則漂木無定。五行不可太盛，八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899490816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"字須得中和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"土厚，即晦火無光之意。水盛，即水泛木浮之意。五行二句，又所以總結之，歸於中和而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"土止水流全福夀，水無土止必傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":88,"lineType":2,"content":"此下言失中和而五行有救，亦作吉論。無救助方㓙如水流而有土，止則禄夀兩全。餘可例見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛多仁，土薄寡信。水旺居垣須有智，金堅主義却能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"為。金水聰眀而好色，水土混雜必多愚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"此言五行性氣太過，中亦各有所盛，偏之為害也。五行分四時，五常配五行，自然之理也。或盛、或薄，或旺、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"或多，或混雜，而仁義智信，聰明愚魯，亦各從其類耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919504896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"遐齡得於中和，夭夀喪於偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":96,"lineType":2,"content":"此又申言人命要禀中和，即前眉夀八字停均之義。若太過不及，失於偏枯，安得遐齡之享哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌尅制併衝，必犯刑名。子卯相刑，門户全無禮徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":98,"lineType":2,"content":"此以下提起地支相衝、相刑言之。辰戌魁罡併衝，必㓙；子卯母子相刑，必亂。乃衝刑之最重者，餘稍輕。寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"申、巳、亥，為四生之局，縱犯尅制刑衝，亦無大害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":142,"lineType":8,"content":"兩干不雜利名齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444198939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"兩干難得不雜，故主利名兼有。然不可一槩言貴，或是財煞，或是官印，或是煞刃，或五行成象，更入格局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"方作貴論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子辛卯相刑，荒淫滚浪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":148,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辛合子卯，刑，干合支刑。丙辛，水象，子卯無禮，故主荒淫滚浪，言極淫也，女命尤忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉全備，酒色昏迷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":150,"lineType":2,"content":"上重子卯，此併論。午酉為四敗之局，號曰遍野桃花。煞全備者多貴，但主酒色昏迷，女命尤忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"因財致禍，貪食種疾，姪男為嗣，義女為妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":152,"lineType":2,"content":"上言財要伏藏為竒，然財者衆所争，故有羊刃劫，則因財致禍，見財不可專也。上言食神制煞為妙，然食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062193679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"者人所食，故有梟神奪，則因食生疾，見食不可貪也。男以官煞為子，如羊刃劫財，官煞為彼用，是兄弟有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":156,"lineType":2,"content":"子，而我無子，故以姪男為嗣。以偏正財為妻，如柱中無財正位，而寄生别宫，是娶他人所養女，故主義女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"為妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"日時相衝，卯酉始生，必主遷移造化；因逢戌亥，平生敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"信神祗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"此又舉。地支中卯酉日月門户，日時遇之，主遷移不定。戌亥為天門，日月逢之，多敬信神祗，或僧道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"隂尅陰，陽尅陽，財神有用。官無官，鬼無鬼，太旺傾危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":162,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以財官為重，故又舉而言之。人皆知正財為用，不知隂能尅隂，陽能尅陽，偏財勝乎正財，造化反為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253505036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"得用。官不可無，官多反主，無官不吉。煞不可有，煞多得從其鬼，反不為害。要之，皆為太旺，身衰不能敵，傾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"危之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"得局失垣，平生不遂；歸垣得局，早歳軒昻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"得局，三合局也。歸垣，干歸禄也。此言人命要生旺成局勢為福。若得局失垣，雖天干類象，而地支三合，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"為日干休囚死絶之地，亦平生不遂。若得局又歸垣，如五星升殿入垣，乃得地得時之謂也，决主早歳發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"福。曲直潤下等格，即得局歸垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"命遇梟神，而與富家營運；龍藏亥卯，經商利賂絲緍。財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"官俱敗者死；食神逢梟者㓙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844693004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"梟神固可惡，小人得之有用，謂其與富家營運，如甲用丙火為食，丙能生戊土為甲之財，壬水却為甲木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":176,"lineType":2,"content":"梟神，受戊驅使，丙火以托甲木，互換相生，為主客之道故也。亦有為商自營運者，謂龍藏亥卯，寅為青龍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"巳為太常，亥卯未，木局八字用，藏亥卯未為用神者，或用財，皆主絲緡之利。財官為禄馬，人最𦂳要，若俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":178,"lineType":2,"content":"在敗絶之地，或行運又到敗絶，用神損氣，安得不死。食神，人之爵星，生財制煞，命中𦂳要，彼梟奪食，煞無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":179,"lineType":2,"content":"所制，財無所生，安得不㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳孤鸞。命遇聰眀詩女；裸形沐浴，日犯濁濫荒淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"此論女命，男亦同。孤鸞乃甲寅、丁巳、戊申、辛亥等日，坐四生之地，故多聰明。祼形沐浴，即子午卯酉四敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":182,"lineType":2,"content":"之地也。月時犯無傷，只怕日干自坐，如甲子、庚午、丁卯、癸酉等日，身坐桃花煞，再遇帶合，故主濁濫荒淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062177295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"丁逢卯日，遇己土，饕食之人；亥乃漿神，逢酉金，嗜盃之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"丁干坐卯木為梟，若遇己為食，故主貪食，或因食生灾。亥為登明，酉加水為酒，酉日生人逢亥必主貪盃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":188,"lineType":2,"content":"更帶刑衝，主落魄或酒死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"歸禄得財而獲福，無財歸禄必須貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄身旺故用財，無財而專歸祿，無用得傷官。食神生財月吉，又怕見官煞竊財之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"財印混雜，終為受困；偏正錯亂，必致傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"貪財壞印，故忌混雜，若先財後印，反主成其福，不以此論。官煞混雜，有去留亦吉，若錯亂則傷身。為㓙女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444264475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"命偏正錯亂，尤為不吉，擇婦者須知之。或曰：偏正就指財之偏正、印之偏正言，但於傷身難通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳忌逢戰鬪，羊刃不喜刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":197,"lineType":2,"content":"此論日干與歳君相犯禍福。葢日犯歳君，以歳為用神者無咎，如六壬日以丙丁為財柱，中原有根，雖犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":198,"lineType":2,"content":"太歳，反為吉。身旺者㓙，弱者無咎。日與運俱犯之，方主大㓙五行有救，亦减分數。最怕天衝地擊，當妙察","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"性情隂陽、物元真理。且如六乙人逢己歳運活木尅活土，却有生意，財源倍有。六甲生人逢戊歳運，死木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":200,"lineType":2,"content":"尅死土，則不吉，重者䘮身。羊刃格不喜歳運刑衝，小人不可犯之。如八字既有羊刃，多煞制伏行羊刃歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"運，亦㓙元有財者更重帶傷。衝刑戰鬪，主禍出不測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"云羊刃衝合歳君，勃然禍至是也。戰鬪獨舉太歳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝獨舉羊刃，指其所最重言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919554048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逢丙擾，多有不仁。癸從戊合，少長無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":206,"lineType":2,"content":"此言人之性情心術。金火相刑，故有此病，且主人剛暴。癸為少隂，戊為老陽，癸戊雖合化，乃無情之合，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"以少長言之。男命戊日見癸，當娶少年之婦；女命癸日見戊，必嫁老年之夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"不從不化，淹留仕路之人；得化得從，顯達功名之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"不通月氣，時無所歸，又犯孤神，不從不化也。若通月氣，時有所歸，則以從化論。夫旺從夫化，妻旺從妻化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":210,"lineType":2,"content":"人之行藏，豈止一事而立，終身無改。故從化成格，則富貴備矣。先論從化，後論財官。從以天干從地支，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生八月，地支重金，則以金論是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"化行禄旺者生；化歸禄絶者死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062160911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":215,"lineType":2,"content":"此言得化得從，要得禄旺，不要死絶。葢化成造化，行夲局，禄旺如丁壬化木，月令春或東南方，運為生，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":216,"lineType":2,"content":"金鄉，或時遇申酉之地為死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"生地相逢，壯年不禄；時歸敗地，老後無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":218,"lineType":2,"content":"生地相逢，是命已有長生。臨官行運復遇之，如庚辛臨官，帝旺在申酉，用丙丁為官，用甲乙為財。火至申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"酉運則病死，是庚辛無官也。木至申酉運則死絶，是庚辛無財也。財官俱敗，用神破傷，雖壯年不祿，時為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"結果。人之生時，最不可居於五行敗地，金敗午，木敗子，水土敗於酉，火敗卯。時為末主，若居敗地，主晚年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"晦滯，破敗無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"丁坐酉金，丙辛遇之絶嗣；財臨煞位，父死而不歸家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889236499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"丙用壬為子，壬敗於酉。辛用丙為子，丙死於酉。時乃子宫，既敗且死，豈有嗣乎？如有嗣，則父必不禄。人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"以財為父，財煞同宫，則難為父。如庚辛用甲為父，年月時見甲申坐煞官，歳運煞旺，主父死他鄉。或云煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"劫煞財坐劫煞，更父位，推賦義亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"八專干支同類，煞運煞年多㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"支干同類，如甲寅、乙卯、丙午、丁未、庚申、辛酉、壬子、癸丑、戊午、己未、戊戌、己丑是也。行運會煞，必主不祿，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"其恃強，與煞相争，煞竟尅身故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"若能詳觀玩覽，貴賤萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":232,"lineType":2,"content":"余見舊註分拆破碎，有失賦旨，故畧註於下，以明作者之意云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757742936114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"真寳賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"明兵部尚書萬育騏撰          萬  吾解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃無尅破，掌兵刑之大權；財印相資没刑衝，登","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"黄閣三公之貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":238,"lineType":2,"content":"正官格喜羊刃，及財印相資，有傷官則尅，有刑衝則破，無印無刃，只有財星資助，亦吉。歳同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺逢印綬，拜薇垣憲府之尊。三合印財會局全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"登五馬諸侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"財官生旺格柱有偏正印再三合印局或財局吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官逢煞刃，兼將相於明時；印綬若相扶，登龍門於早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253488652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"歳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":246,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官格，身弱，喜刃印相資扶則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官得食神重輔，麟閣圖魏相之功；歳運忌制伏刑衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"再傷官而禍至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官得食神重叠相扶吉。所忌刑衝及制伏太過，復行傷官運，不測灾來。柱中無官喜行財，官運無印喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"行印綬，運主遷官。歳運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"財資七煞，威權獨壓萬人；印若相扶，斷定官居極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":252,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞格喜財資助，又得印化最吉，惟煞故主有權，得印故主極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776931975220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"月會既同煞刃，英名儔漢室之霍光；時歳復帶印財，髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"位埓中興之鄧禹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞劫刃同在月令，歳時有財有印最貴，義同上文，但此又兼刃言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"煞失時而印無氣，更主旺而任常流；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞印綬若不當令司權，而日干自旺，用神輕㣲，不過清虚冷淡之職。歳運行財煞則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"印司令而煞相扶，再見財而官翰苑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"印綬格，要當時月令日支，又得重生氣旺，不見刑衝破害，稍得一煞一財為妙，太過不宜，財印兩停，乃常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":262,"lineType":2,"content":"流也。賦又云印綬重逢，官居翰苑是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349680179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財時上見官，早歳名標金榜；更得食神相輔，少年日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"近天顔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"時上偏財格，歳月有官星，又得食助，准上文。忌比刼逢比，百無一遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳見財而隠官，居極髙之重任；柱運逢印而無土，處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"至下之孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":270,"lineType":2,"content":"福徳如壬癸日生，冬三月之例。喜財官資助，干支作合，或得火局，及辰戌丑未，但逢一字為妙。若無財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"而逢印綬，不行財官而行印綬，及北方之運，刑妻尅子，孤寡貧賤之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬趨艮，透財印以為竒；官煞相侵，反貧窮而下賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001225254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬日逢壬寅時，乃趨艮格也。歳月再見寅，天干透丁辛為妙。富貴雙全，最忌官煞，或行運見之，六親骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":276,"lineType":2,"content":"肉分散，貧薄婢僕之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲趨乾，喜財印而位重名髙；歳運衝刑，併煞官而灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"興禍至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日時逢乙亥，乃趨乾格也。歳月再見亥，又得財星重遇，印綬生身，正官自然出現，再行財旺之地吉。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":280,"lineType":2,"content":"己字刑衝，官煞尅破，甲乙刼奪。歳運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"財宿疊逢，得印生，少年受福；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":282,"lineType":2,"content":"即先財後印，反成其福，不可以財壞印為嫌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919586816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"倒衝帶印，遇財食，早歳成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":286,"lineType":2,"content":"倒衝禄馬格，乃丙午、丁巳、辛亥、癸亥等日，柱有偏印，又行財食運為貴，忌填實官煞不中。賦又云倒衝帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":287,"lineType":2,"content":"印，早歳成名，財食兼資，身近丹墀是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳扶干，喜財星而嫌制伏；印星在運，會羊刃而掌兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"年干七煞為歳徳，不宜重見，最喜財星及印綬，羊刃不可制伏。歳運同，如甲申、己巳、戊子、癸亥，歳徳無制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"有財生煞得用，有印化煞助身，有刃合煞扶身，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"二徳配官，王陵為漢朝之相；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776931991604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛日生九月，以丙為天月，二徳又為正官，喜財是資助，忌傷官尅制。賦又云平邦國，綂六師，頼官變為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":296,"lineType":2,"content":"二徳是也。如乙亥、丙戌、辛丑、戊子合格。又官變徳，居官無禍；財變徳，得善中財帛。印變徳，主受父祖貽慶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"無禍；日干變徳，則主夲身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"財星徳秀，謝安為晉代之公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊己以甲乙為官，壬癸為財，二徳透干，為徳秀之辰，無庚辛制伏，不被比刼争奪，大貴。又如乙日以庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"為官，生己酉丑月，丙丁用庚辛為財，生己酉丑月之例。賦又云王商扶漢，因財官而為徳秀之榮是也。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"以徳秀為福徳秀氣，更是財官尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官多而見官，頑石産玉；原有官而再見，灾禍連綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919603200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":305,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官格要柱中重見傷官，如有一位正官為貴，無官喜行官運，傷官如石，正官如玉。若有官再行官運，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":306,"lineType":2,"content":"禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官如帶煞刃，出將相而入公侯；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":308,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官為主柱，帶煞刃，又得印綬，當時得令，有相益之情，不被刑衝，乃極貴之格。賦又云傷官帶刃印全備，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"掌兵符之重任是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"徳秀若助傷官，握兵權而伏鈇鉞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"此又兼徳秀言之，皆以傷官格為主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"地全子午卯酉，成大格而文武經邦；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757742985266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"四仲全看天干何如，須成大格為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"柱列巳亥寅申，更竒儀而威權震主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"四孟全㸔天干何如，更得竒儀為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"木生卯月，時會午而震動離眀。運至西南，官居極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"此木火通明格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"食遇印多，再刼衝，天年必夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"此食格所忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"柱盛食神，運財鄉，功名有准。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793318989875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"一云權臣内使，此食格所喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"朝陽帶印資馬宿，青瑣黄門；柱無財印，職居民牧。歳運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌填實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"六隂朝陽格，喜印綬財星在歳月之中，入格而無財印，則减分數。運行財印，官居轉運，忌衝刑填實。賦又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"云：朝陽帶印，清朝達士，財星資助，非青瑣之榮，即風紀之任。柱無印財，多居民牧，職守専城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠貴帶食資印曜，薇垣藩省。柱有官煞，貧窮下賤。運途","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜刑衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":332,"lineType":2,"content":"六乙鼠貴格，喜食神重見，及印綬則吉，忌官煞衝刑害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844709388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑遥合巳宫，柱印財而為極寳；歳運若無輔佐，登卑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"秩而坐寒氊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"子丑遥巳二格，要柱有財印必貴，無則否，運遇財印亦發賦。又云子丑遥合巳宫，得財印而為至寳是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"論道經邦，喜財官自禄而自旺；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日以辛為官，得酉建禄，己土為財，長生在酉之例，入斯象大貴。忌刑衝傷官運歳同，如呉嶽尚書，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":340,"lineType":2,"content":"子、癸酉、甲辰、甲子合格，庚午年卒。平生正氣君子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"調元賛化，因三竒自旺而自生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":342,"lineType":2,"content":"正官正印正財，為三竒日，以庚為正官，得己字長生，壬為正印，生於申，戊土正財生於申，入斯象大貴。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001274406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"譚論尚書，庚辰、甲申、丁未、丙午，財官印俱旺。胡宗憲尚書，壬申、辛亥、丁酉、壬寅，財官建禄，印長生，火自生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":346,"lineType":2,"content":"於酉，為貴神之地，又化木成象，所以威制四省，官居一品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"欄，又得印禄之相助，官居補衮。阿衡火刼，兼歳運之不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"和，反作貧窮而下賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"此格柱中有禄神偏正印，天干得財印為妙。若見火神，刼刃太重，歳運不和，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢財印，青年及第登科；歳運刑衝，官煞逢之不妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄格，歳月時中有印有財，地支三合為妙。運行財印之地吉。忌刑衝破害，官煞破格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"金水清沉被傷，文章顯達而夀筭難延；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319022643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中己酉丑金局，申子辰水局，二局全，乃曰金白水清，却被天干丙丁戊己混尅，則文而不夀。賦云：金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":356,"lineType":2,"content":"清澄被傷，顔子秀而不實是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"木火衰盛不均，功名蹭蹬而夭折無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":358,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日生，柱中丙丁午己火盛，即乙木叠逢火位，名為氣散之文。柱無財印，灰飛烟滅，尅子傷妻，或殘疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":359,"lineType":2,"content":"功名雖有，亦小就而已。得刼刃幇助，壬癸生扶戊己，資益則貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"雲龍風虎若相從，擬作聖朝之大噐；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"雲龍風虎，如甲乙生春三月，或亥卯未月，為青龍之宿，天干要壬癸水，謂之雲龍相從。或庚申辛酉，但得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":362,"lineType":2,"content":"一字，為西方白虎之神，愛亥卯未，邀合己字，為巺風，則貴。若見填實，又無雲雨，謂之旱龍。有陽而無陰，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319006259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"君而無臣，剛柔不相濟，反為中庸不達之士也。或以辰為龍，寅為虎，壬為雲，巳為風，局全寅辰巳壬者，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":366,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"飛禄倒衝資印綬，必為昭代之名公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":368,"lineType":2,"content":"飛天禄馬，倒衝之象，喜印綬財，忌正官七煞衝刑填實，若行印財及三合之地，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖旺而官禄㣲輕，馬氏育菁莪於絳帳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":370,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅日用辛為官禄，生冬三月，或四五月，用神既淺，又無財星資助，止為師儒之命。如生夏而財星資","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":371,"lineType":2,"content":"助，富擬陶朱。若尅破制伏，火重則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"格不清而用神休廢，蕭曹起刀筆於西秦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319039027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":375,"lineType":2,"content":"義同上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙若遇乾宫，會辰龍而必貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":377,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙二字，多逢干頭地支，見亥一位，又得辰字，名羣龍無首，吉，是剛能變柔，入斯象，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"木神如逢壬癸，得巳午以為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日生人，得壬癸印生扶，支帶巳午，是有火氣。水火既濟，龍得飛騰之象，雲行雨施之功，命值斯象，位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":380,"lineType":2,"content":"近清光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"庚遇壬癸，坐煞印而周瑜位重；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":382,"lineType":2,"content":"六庚日生，柱中壬癸多，身坐七煞印綬者，主大貴。如何尚書壬子、癸丑、庚午、丙子，余命壬午、癸丑、庚寅、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001290790"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"戌，俱合此象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"龜蛇持劒，兼金刃而賈復名髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸日生，柱中丙火多，或寅午戌、申子辰二局，水屬龜，火屬蛇，名龜蛇持劒之象。柱無金，其劔不出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛重而時見己亥，虎嘯風生，得戊己以相資，官居極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":390,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛日主，再見庚辛。干歳月時中得一己為巽風，或得亥亦可喜。甲乙亥卯未，運行東南，權髙禄重。行北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":391,"lineType":2,"content":"方，富入西，禍莫測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣相生，稱五行之順食，位近三台；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319055411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":395,"lineType":2,"content":"一氣相生，即甲生丙，丙生戊，戊生庚，五行順食，更地支互益者，大貴。或以天元一氣解之，則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶刃，遇火地之炎眀，官居内閣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":397,"lineType":2,"content":"金刃格。柱中有陽刃，又行火鄉，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏官，喜刼刃印財而居歳月；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":399,"lineType":2,"content":"時上。偏官格。歳月時中有財資印化，刃扶身強主風憲之權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"父傳子道，兼文武將相而顯朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":401,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日生逢壬午時者，是乙屬東方青帝之神，午屬南方火帝之神。乙為父，時為子，得干上壬水，反生乙木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":402,"lineType":2,"content":"是父傳子道之象，青赤相投之妙。入此格者，功髙一世，寵壓千官。不宜水盛，乙木有泛，即前木生卯月，時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889285651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":405,"lineType":2,"content":"㑹午而震動離明，運至西南，官居極品是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官透而正官隠，運煞印而位重權髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":407,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官透於歳月時干，正官隠於地支柱内，財印七煞全者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"地天交而隂陽感，得戊己而三台八座；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":409,"lineType":2,"content":"日時得亥為乾天，歳月得申為坤地，而干透戊己，是地在天上，有隂陽交感之意，内陽外隂，健順之象。入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":410,"lineType":2,"content":"此格者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛金繁，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"眀而公忠正直；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":412,"lineType":2,"content":"木頼金削，繁則金太多，要火制金，公忠正直，因金木而言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062226447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，遇長生而聰眀出衆；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":416,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛日生於申子辰月，地支坐己，柱有壬癸，無火土夾雜，主聰眀有文學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"火明木秀，逢土現而早占鰲頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":418,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日生，柱中有己，或丙丁寅戌字，在春生竒特。若地支有午戌亥卯未，各得一字，亦是不拘。甲乙日生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"水木在春生，遇土金而作公侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":420,"lineType":2,"content":"水見土，木見金為官。水見金印，木見土財，春則木旺水休，互相資助，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢火煉，早年出仕；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"木得金裁，㓜歳成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253554188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"此言五行之相濟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"金多失火，嗟性地之兇頑；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛無金，嘆功名之不遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而無木疏通，困苦奔波之軰；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛而無土制伏，破家淫蕩之人；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"火盛而無水濟死而無悔之暴。夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"木衰火盛變灰飛，功名遲而難迯夭折；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清被梟害，文章秀而莫永天年；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889318419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"此總言五行偏黨，無制化，皆為不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，脫梟神而文章益顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"與前金白水清，遇長生而聪眀出衆互㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官兩露，遇二徳而爵位崇髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"二徳，天月二徳也。煞官兩露疑混，得此解之。故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"財資七煞，子儀司將相之髙權；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中財旺生煞，煞生印，又得長生之地。日干旺，格局純，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶煞冠凖，擅廟堂之大噐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757743001650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"金神重犯歳時，月令却逢七煞，大貴忌刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳逢財煞栽根，早登顯仕；更加印刃無妬合，預擢髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":448,"lineType":2,"content":"與前歳徳扶干，喜財星而嫌制伏；印星在運，㑹羊刃而掌兵刑義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳逢財，少年請舉；歳徳帶刃，早歳成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":450,"lineType":2,"content":"歳徳為重煞，故屢言之請舉少而成名，早擢髙科而登顯仕。以年管初年，煞主威風故也。假如甲日見庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":451,"lineType":2,"content":"年，為歳徳柱中，要戊己資煞，己酉丑栽根帶刃，喜行卬綬，忌正官妬合之辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"月七煞而時歳食，肅憲府風霜之號令；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253570572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"食神制煞，理固然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"月煞印而時傷官，受鳳閣龍樓之厚寵；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"月令有煞印，歳干支得之為極妙。要時透傷官，為印之妻，年煞之制，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"日丙火而時入亥宫，麗乎天而文眀四海；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"六丙日，時得己亥，亥屬乾為天，火在天上，無所不照。命有斯象，自㓜至老，貴顯崇髙。掌兵刑之任，上佐天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":460,"lineType":2,"content":"子，下順四時，外撫四夷，所忌刑衝破害，有救者吉。賦云：陽火時逢亥位，文明光照乎四海是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"干陽熒而時逢己丑，出乎地而照耀山川；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":462,"lineType":2,"content":"丙日逢己丑時，是日出土上之象。順而麗乎天，大明之徳，如安國康侯，多受大賜；命之值此鼎鼐股肱之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776932089908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"任，如姚淶狀元戊申戊午丙辰己丑合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"又云六丙時臨己丑，日在地上為極顯是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"時辛亥而日逢丁，乃時三竒而科名早中；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":467,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁日見辛亥時，辛為偏財，亥中甲木正印，壬水正官，謂之時上三竒，必主少年登科，富貴長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":467,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":467,"lineType":2,"content":"又云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":468,"lineType":2,"content":"隂火時亥，富貴悠悠是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"月建申而歳時遇子，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"順而將相可期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"欲知富貴，先觀月令乃提綱。月建申，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"，為地；年支子，居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"，為水。地水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"師卦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"。水不外乎地，兵不外乎民，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"此象者大貴。子時亦然。日支子者，則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"，日隂金透，甲乙為三台之貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776932106292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"午時生人，年支得己字，日得辛金為主，金用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"木為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"火為官，名曰内得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"順，而外得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"眀之象。柔進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"而上行，得中而應乎剛。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"居月令，則非入格大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"木秀火眀，春秉令入，斯象奪榜眼之魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"重在春生，即前火眀木秀，逢土現而早占鰲頭之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，結局而位至三公；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":480,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲人食丙，要火局；己人食辛，要金局。但得一字，更有刃助，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，坐官而勲髙一品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"日主坐下官星，歳月時中，又有刃食之現，大貴。所嫌者，偏印衝刑，若行財官二運，勃然驟發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513148456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃，班超萬里封侯；歳月得時，周勃特然入相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":486,"lineType":2,"content":"正官之格，用神要當。時柱有刼，刃為正官妻財，則剛柔相濟，却得財星為貴。官星刼刃，兩現天干之上，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。賦又云官星帶刃，貴不可言。歳月透露，周勃特然入相是也。得時以官星乘旺言，帶刃以不拘干支言；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"透露則直指所重者言之也。刃為㓙煞，官食帶之，皆作權貴㸔如李邦珍都憲，癸酉己未，壬子庚子合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雙美，透財印而居臺省之尊；運至比肩，更刑衝抱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"守株之拙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳日坐向四月，壬午日坐向午月。天干透財印，貴不宜北方，運又怕刑衝，宜斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺，天干透露為竒，而曵紫拖朱；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889351187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱財星旺，不必正官透財，自生官絶竒。或財官兩透，居生旺之地，皆主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官，印刃相扶為妙，而三台八座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中，財星旺得令，又印劫扶持，大貴。再莫行財鄉，運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"干食神而時騎禄馬，初年題虎榜之榮名；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日見壬午時，辛日見癸巳時是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"透印綬而格得財官，早歳鎮邉隅之重任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"財官之格，要歳時透印干為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"日干健旺而印刃相扶，龔勝盡漢家之死節；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844742156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：煞旺而得印刃之扶。龔勝死節於西漢，是四柱純煞。或官星從煞得印刃，透出天干，乃忠節之良","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":506,"lineType":2,"content":"臣也。前言日干旺而印刃相扶，則太過，焉得好處，當以後為正。考龔勝，漢之處士，而能死節，豈非五行太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"過之傷歟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃而印綬帶煞，元齡歩唐代之瀛洲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"三公之任，在乎煞刃司權；各遇長生，更得財資極貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":510,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲用庚為煞，乙用辛為煞，柱有巳子則煞。長生甲見乙，乙見甲為刃，柱有亥午為刃，長生更得財資，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"印化刃極貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"司要樞，總戎政，因刼帶印以資官；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319120947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"月令時上正官，要羊刃資之，如甲用辛為官，有乙字資官是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"伸枉抑，理寃愆，為財生煞而助印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱七煞重叠，又得財官資助，則煞得勢復生乎印矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"進直言，趨金闕，因煞刃兩露於天干；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"此是煞格，而煞刃並現。歳月時中，主言路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"居翰苑而掌絲綸，為正官歸禄於四柱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄乃正官，如丙用癸為官，有子字，則癸禄居子，在冬三月生妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：掌絲綸之命，列玉堂之職，因貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":522,"lineType":2,"content":"禄而得清竒是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001323558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"年正印而月正官，居國監翰林之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":526,"lineType":2,"content":"正官喜現於月令之中，正印要露於歳元之上，不見衝尅之神。准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"格清竒而時得令，唱鴻臚玉殿之名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"格局純和，不雜用神，得令有氣，無刑衝破害，大貴之造。賦又云格清局正，玉殿傳臚是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"平邦國，綂六師，賴官星變為天徳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"解見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"理隂陽，登宰輔，因禄馬又帶長生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"正財正官俱有長生，得刃生食，食生財，財生官，官生印，印生身，有周流不息之妙，必主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513164840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"有蒂，調和燮理之權，有蒂長生是也。只財官長生就貴，長生指所居長生之地言，不必要刃食相生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"解","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"格局純和而日干自弱，覧泉石而好幽棲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"用神雖得時日，主衰不勝，却為林泉晦迹之人，遇運扶身亦發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"格局薄弱而用神輕㣲，縱資生而無過小職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":539,"lineType":2,"content":"如其所用之神不得時令，縱得資益之字，不過小官，比前格局純和者不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而支神厚載，畏元武而喜青龍。格局苟逢，必膺大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
